observations.classification: Previously published current conditional finding; this packet independently traces its assigned validators and connecting support without new duplicate count.
observations.claim: BuffeDesign independently checks optional courses and breath patterns. For courses the plate-count and seam bounds are checked; breath height is checked against a generic 50–950 range. The burgonet construction makes a shortened top-course outer chart from its boundary and overlap but creates openings using the full 100 mm chart height. PiercedDomain then rejects a hole point outside the outer chart or too close to its edge before triangulation.
observations.conditions_and_limits: A separately published assessment already records a source-derived 820-permille, three-course conditional example, assuming otherwise valid controls; it reports an early structured VisorOpeningSpacing rejection rather than invalid geometry publication. This packet adds the newly assigned source reads and trace, not another defect or runtime/UI observation. Actual supported design reachability, intended policy for placement, and other geometry consumers remain open.

observations.classification: Source-backed ownership/editor-state question; no new unique defect count.
observations.claim: BuffeCourses stores and validates upper_boundary for both admitted plate counts 2 and 3, documenting it as the second seam used for three faceplates. The editor exposes the upper seam control even for two and labels it for three. The host top-course selection and inspected shader string use the lower boundary for both two-course indices; they pass/store the upper value, which the observed two-course indexing does not use.
observations.conditions_and_limits: The value may be intentionally retained so a user can prepare or restore it when switching to three faceplates. Whether this should be an inactive preset, disabled control, or variant-owned payload is a product/ownership decision. This source read does not prove UI interaction, a visual change, all consumers, hash equivalence, product malfunction or a need to remove the value. Do not automatically alias it with the separately established breath/course geometry relation.
observations.future_direction: Clarify persistence and editor expectations for two versus three courses, then reconcile semantic variant and validation ownership only if appropriate. No repair or UI validation occurred.

observations.classification: Bounded nonfinding on the selected ordinary recipe path.
observations.claim: HelmetDesign::validate invokes present crown validation, and for Burgonet invokes present buffe validation. The ordinary helmet recipe calls design.validate before building parts. With no courses the buffe selects one shell; otherwise validated BuffeCourses accepts only 2–3. On successful collection, the selected face vector therefore has at least one element and the fixed three-entry boundary table covers course indices, before the later last-index calculation.
observations.conditions_and_limits: This reasoning applies to the inspected normal recipe and successful collection, not arbitrary direct helpers, all helmet designs, the native device, or physical/geometric validity. Independent fluting validation bounds count and width before selected crown generation; public raw PlateFluting helpers and other callers remain separate.

lenses.assessment: Named editor labels and closed enum variants serve presentation/serialization; no prose classifier demonstrated.
Fullness, ridge, seam, extent and angle values carry explicit units/ranges, including meaningful values greater than 1000. Raw numerical chart adapters are separate from semantic owner policy.
HelmetCrown and BuffeDesign own distinct controls; Millimeters/Permille do not by themselves enforce child-specific admission. Upper seam variant ownership remains a question.
Existing HelmetCrown, BuffeCourses and VisorBreaths are consumed through the selected recipe. No compatible existing owner has been proved missing in native shader coordinates.
Two- versus three-course difference could own a second seam or retain a dormant preset; decide intended editing persistence before reshaping it.

Courses validator bounds lower seam before lower+180; fluting validation checks order and fade range before end-start and fade*2. These selected operations cannot overflow u16 for earlier accepted operands.
Independent breath and course gates do not encode shortened-chart containment; reconnect existing REVIEW-BUFFE-BREATH-COURSE-CONTEXT-95E rather than counting it again.
Ordinary helmet recipe invokes design validation before construction; raw serde/public fields and direct helper routes remain distinct and not exhaustively traced.
Optional buffe, courses and breaths express absence, while count2/count3 plus upper seam present an unresolved optional payload/preset decision.
Full-face breath height and top-course outer chart express distinct coordinate extents; their relationship is currently checked at a later geometry boundary.
Assigned source bytes match at historical 6533 and pinned 95e; this does not prove unchanged full product, shader outputs, visual appearance or replay.
Selected recipe -> HelmetDesign -> crown/buffe -> courses/breaths -> burgonet/pierced-domain source edges are visible, with separately read editor source; external producers remain open.
Serde derives exist on selected value records; no safe removal of hand-maintained conversions, validation, or constructors was established.
